issue_title: Fix RootModel equality with type aliases
issue_body: RootModel equality fails when equivalent PEP 695 TypeAliasType aliases are used; PR 13830 proposes unwrapping __value__ before comparison.
problem_statement: RootModel equality fails when equivalent PEP 695 TypeAliasType aliases are used.
expected_behavior: Equivalent aliases compare equal and distinct parametrizations remain unequal.
environment: Windows AMD64; Python 3.11.15; pydantic-core==2.49.0; typing-extensions==4.16.0; typing-inspection==0.4.4; annotated-types==0.8.0
acceptance_test: hidden acceptance must assert equivalent TypeAliasType RootModels compare equal and distinct parametrizations remain unequal
